name: ArenaLocale
description: The words Arena draws itself and the locale it formats dates in, provided once for a tree of components. Each word resolves to the component's own member when one answers it, then to the provided locale, then to the default here. A field whose default carries a {name} is a sentence with a value in it: Arena replaces each {name} it knows, so a language may put them in any order.

locale.description: A BCP 47 tag. Every date and every file size Arena formats uses it; hour labels keep a 24-hour clock whatever it says.

calendarToday.description: The calendar button that returns to the current period.

calendarPrevious.description: Names the calendar button that moves back one period.

calendarNext.description: Names the calendar button that moves forward one period.

calendarRegion.description: Names the calendar's region. {range} is the range title.

calendarGrid.description: Names the calendar's grid. {range} is the range title.

calendarEventActions.description: Names the button that opens a calendar event's action panel.

tableSortBy.description: Labels the sort select a table draws in its card layout.

tableEmpty.description: What a table shows when no row is written and its empty slot is not filled.

toastClose.description: Names a dismissible toast's close button.

toastPinned.description: The mark a toast that does not dismiss itself carries.

toastPinnedHint.description: The title on the pinned mark.

sheetClose.description: Names a dismissible sheet's close button.

alertDismiss.description: Names a dismissible alert's close button.

tagRemove.description: Names a removable tag's remove button, read before the tag's own text, so each button says which tag it removes.

spinnerLabel.description: Names a spinner when its own label is absent.

switchConfirmHint.description: The title on the guard glyph of a switch that asks before it changes.

fileInputChoose.description: The text of a file input's trigger when it takes one file.

fileInputChooseMultiple.description: The text of a file input's trigger when `multiple` lets it take more than one.

fileInputDrop.description: The line beside a file input's trigger when its zone takes a drop.

fileInputNone.description: What a file input announces when it holds no file.

fileInputCount.description: What a file input announces when it holds files. {count} is how many.

fileInputTooLarge.description: A file input's refusal of a file over its size limit. {name} is the file's name; {size} is the limit, a number and a unit symbol.

fileInputWrongType.description: A file input's refusal of a file its accept list does not match. {name} is the file's name.

fileInputSurplus.description: A file input's refusal of a file past the one a single-file input holds. {name} is the file's name.

fileInputRequired.description: Read in a required file input's trigger name, between the label and the trigger's text, and never seen.

bulkActionBarClear.description: The text of the button that clears the selection.

bulkActionBarClearLabel.description: Names the button that clears the selection.

bulkActionBarCount.description: The selection count. {count} is drawn in bold; {noun} is the bar's noun.

bulkActionBarNoun.description: What is counted, plural, when the bar's own noun is absent.

multiSelectEmpty.description: What a multi-select's list shows when no option matches. {query} is what was typed.

multiSelectLoading.description: What a multi-select's list shows while its options are fetched.

multiSelectCount.description: Announced politely after the text changes, since focus stays in the field. {count} is how many options the list holds; the count stands last, so one sentence serves every number.

multiSelectClear.description: Names the control that empties the whole selection.

multiSelectMore.description: The marker drawn in place of the chips past maxVisible. {count} is how many are collapsed.

multiSelectMoreLabel.description: Names the collapsed count for assistive technology. {count} is how many are collapsed.

multiSelectMax.description: Announced politely when a choice is blocked because the cap is reached. {max} is the cap.

commandPaletteSearch.description: Names the search field when no placeholder names it.

commandPalettePlaceholder.default: Search for an action or project…
commandPalettePlaceholder.description: The search field's placeholder when the palette's own is absent.

commandPaletteEscape.description: The key hint beside the search field.

commandPaletteEmpty.description: What the list shows when nothing matches. {query} is what was typed.

comboboxEmpty.description: What a combobox's list shows when no option matches. {query} is what was typed.

comboboxLoading.description: What a combobox's list shows while its options are fetched.

comboboxCount.description: Announced politely after the text changes, since focus stays in the field. {count} is how many options the list holds; the count stands last, so one sentence serves every number.

linkExternal.description: Said after the text of an external ArenaLink and never drawn, so a reader knows the link opens another tab before following it.

copyButtonLabel.description: Names a copy button when its own label is absent.

copyButtonCopied.description: Announced once in place when a copy button wrote its text to the clipboard. The button keeps its name.

copyButtonFailed.description: Announced once in place when the clipboard refused a copy button's text or the page has none.

meterOptimum.description: The standing a meter draws and says when its value lies in the region holding its optimum.

meterFair.description: The standing a meter draws and says when its value lies in a region beside the one holding its optimum.

meterPoor.description: The standing a meter draws and says when its value lies in the region opposite the one holding its optimum.

stepperComplete.description: Spoken before the label of a stepper step that lies behind the current one.

stepperCurrent.description: Spoken before the label of the stepper step the process stands at.

stepperUpcoming.description: Spoken before the label of a stepper step that lies ahead of the current one.

stepperError.description: Spoken after the position word of a stepper step that needs attention.

timelineCurrent.description: Spoken before the title of the timeline milestone the timeline stands at.

timelineUpcoming.description: Spoken before the title of a timeline milestone that lies ahead. A complete milestone is silent.

numberFieldDecrease.description: Names the number field's decrease stepper button.

numberFieldIncrease.description: Names the number field's increase stepper button.

sliderStart.description: Joins a range slider's label to name the thumb at the start of the span.

sliderEnd.description: Joins a range slider's label to name the thumb at the end of the span.

sliderRange.description: The readout of a range slider. {start} and {end} are the two values, each written with the prefix, the suffix and the format.

pinInputCell.description: Names each cell of a pin input. {index} is the cell's position from 1 and {total} is how many cells the code has.

filterBarClear.description: The text of a filter bar's button that removes every applied filter.

filterBarClearLabel.description: Names a filter bar's button that removes every applied filter.

filterBarApplied.description: Names the list of a filter bar's applied filters.

onboardingBack.description: The button that returns to the previous step.

onboardingSkip.description: The button that leaves the tour.

onboardingNext.description: The button that moves to the next step.

onboardingDone.description: The button that closes the last step.

onboardingStep.description: Names a step that has no title and no eyebrow. {current} counts from one; {total} is the number of steps.

onboardingProgress.description: Names the progress dots. {current} counts from one; {total} is the number of steps.

confirmDialogEyebrow.description: The confirmation's eyebrow when its own is absent.

confirmDialogConfirm.description: The confirming button when its own label is absent.

confirmDialogCancel.description: The cancelling button when its own label is absent.

confirmDialogRequire.description: The prompt above the field a confirmation requires. {text} is what must be typed.

errorStateTitle.description: An error state's title when its own is absent.

lineChartName.description: A line chart's accessible name. {label} is the chart's label.

barChartName.description: A bar chart's accessible name. {label} is the chart's label.

horizontalBarChartName.description: A horizontal bar chart's accessible name. {label} is the chart's label.

pyramidChartName.description: A pyramid chart's accessible name, which reads as the horizontal bars it draws. {label} is the chart's label.

doughnutChartName.description: A doughnut chart's accessible name. {label} is the chart's label.

doughnutChartPieName.description: A doughnut chart's accessible name in its pie shape. {label} is the chart's label.

radarChartName.description: A radar chart's accessible name. {label} is the chart's label.

scatterChartName.description: A scatter chart's accessible name. {label} is the chart's label.

sparklineChartName.description: A sparkline's accessible name. {label} is the sparkline's label.

gaugeChartName.description: A gauge chart's accessible name. {label} is the chart's label.

gaugeTableMeasure.description: The first heading of the data table a gauge chart writes.

gaugeTableValue.description: The second heading of the data table a gauge chart writes, and the name of its row for the reading.

gaugeTableMinimum.description: The name of the row of a gauge chart's table that holds the low end of the scale.

gaugeTableMaximum.description: The name of the row of a gauge chart's table that holds the high end of the scale.

gaugeTableRange.description: A band's range in a gauge chart's table. {from} and {to} are its two ends, written by the chart's value writer.

funnelChartName.description: A funnel chart's accessible name. {label} is the chart's label.

funnelConversionStep.description: The heading of a funnel chart's column, and the tooltip line, that holds each stage's share of the stage before it.

funnelConversionTotal.description: The heading of a funnel chart's column, and the tooltip line, that holds each stage's share of the first stage.

chartTableCategory.description: The first heading of the data table a categorical chart writes.

chartTablePoint.description: The first heading of the data table a line chart writes.

chartTableAxis.description: The first heading of the data table a radar chart writes.

chartTableSeries.description: The first heading of the data table a scatter chart writes.

doughnutChartPieLegend.description: Names the legend in the pie shape.
